name: Kaikatsu Club Shinjuku Kabukicho
nameJa: 快活CLUB 新宿歌舞伎町店
description: A large manga kissa (a manga and internet cafe with private booths) open all night with free Wi-Fi, an outlet in every lockable room, and showers, so it is a safe place to wait for the first train.

name: Kaikatsu Club Shibuya Center-gai
nameJa: 快活CLUB 渋谷センター街店
description: A branch of the Kaikatsu Club manga and internet cafe chain in the Center-gai shopping street with free Wi-Fi and power outlets in lockable private rooms, handy at night in central Shibuya.

name: Kaikatsu Club Ikebukuro East Exit Ekimae
nameJa: 快活CLUB 池袋東口駅前店
description: A 24-hour manga and internet cafe about one minute from Ikebukuro Station with free Wi-Fi, full power outlets, reclining and flat seats, and free showers.

name: Kaikatsu Club Akihabara Ekimae
nameJa: 快活CLUB 秋葉原駅前店
description: A 24-hour manga and internet cafe near the Akihabara Electric Town exit with free Wi-Fi, an outlet in each soundproof lockable booth, and showers.

name: Gran Cyber Cafe Bagus Shinjuku
nameJa: グランサイバーカフェ バグース 新宿店
description: A 24-hour internet cafe about five minutes from Shinjuku Station east exit with free Wi-Fi, power at the private booths, plus billiards, darts, and a shower room.

name: Gran Cyber Cafe Bagus Shibuya Bunkamura-dori
nameJa: グランサイバーカフェ バグース 渋谷文化村通り店
description: A 24-hour internet cafe on Bunkamura-dori with high-speed free Wi-Fi, power at the lockable private rooms, and free device chargers to borrow.

name: Jiyu Kukan NEXT Ikebukuro West Exit ROSA
nameJa: 自遊空間 NEXT池袋西口ROSA店
description: A 24-hour branch of the Jiyu Kukan manga and internet cafe chain near Ikebukuro west exit with free Wi-Fi and lockable rooms that reach the ceiling, plus darts and karaoke.

name: Manboo Plus Shibuya Center-gai
nameJa: マンボープラス 渋谷センター街店
address: 24-8 Udagawacho, Leisure Plaza Building (reception 2F), Shibuya-ku, Tokyo
description: A 24-hour branch of the Manboo manga and internet cafe chain about three minutes from Shibuya Station with free Wi-Fi, power outlets at most seats, and lockable private rooms.

name: Manboo Net Room Shinjuku Main Store
nameJa: ネットルーム マンボー 新宿総本店
address: 2-6-12 Shinjuku, Hakuho Shinjuku Dai-15 Building, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo
description: A Manboo internet cafe with fully enclosed lockable private rooms, free Wi-Fi, and power at each booth, about two minutes from Shinjuku-Gyoemmae Station.

name: Customa Cafe Kabukicho
nameJa: カスタマカフェ 歌舞伎町店
address: 1-21-1 Kabukicho, Dai-2 Toa Kaikan Building 7F, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo
description: A 24-hour manga and internet cafe in Kabukicho with soundproof, lockable private rooms, high-speed internet, and power at the booths.

name: Customa Cafe Ueno
nameJa: カスタマカフェ 上野店
address: 6-7-9 Ueno, AS Dai-1 Building, Taito-ku, Tokyo
description: A 24-hour manga and internet cafe about two minutes from Ueno Station with free Wi-Fi, power at the booths, and 92 lockable private rooms.

name: DiCE Shibuya Chitose Kaikan
nameJa: DiCE 渋谷ちとせ会館店
description: A branch of the DiCE manga and internet cafe chain about five minutes from Shibuya Hachiko exit where every seat is a fully private room with free Wi-Fi and power.

name: DiCE Ikebukuro
address: 1-11-11 Higashi-Ikebukuro, White City Building 2F-10F, Toshima-ku, Tokyo
description: A large 24-hour DiCE manga and internet cafe two minutes from Ikebukuro east exit with free Wi-Fi, power at the booths, and about 250 seats in many room types.

name: Hailey'5 Cafe Shibuya
address: 13-11 Udagawacho, KN Shibuya 1 Building 7F, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo
description: A 24-hour, upscale internet cafe about five minutes from Shibuya Station with free Wi-Fi and comfortable lockable private rooms, useful when you miss the last train.

name: Aprecio Shinjuku Hygeia
nameJa: アプレシオ 新宿ハイジア店
address: 2-44-1 Kabukicho, Hygeia Building B1F, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo
description: A 24-hour comic and internet cafe in the Hygeia building in Kabukicho with free Wi-Fi, power at the booths, reclining and flat seats, and a women-only area.

name: McDonald's Roppongi Hills
nameJa: マクドナルド 六本木ヒルズ店
description: A 24-hour McDonald's at Roppongi Hills with free Wi-Fi and some seats that have power outlets, a cheap place to sit through the night.

name: McDonald's Ueno-Okachimachi
nameJa: マクドナルド 上野御徒町店
address: 4-4 Ueno, B and V Building, Taito-ku, Tokyo
description: A 24-hour McDonald's near Okachimachi with free Wi-Fi, though seating is takeout-only in the early morning hours and power outlets are not confirmed.

name: McDonald's Ikebukuro East Exit
nameJa: マクドナルド 池袋東口店
description: A 24-hour McDonald's near the Ikebukuro east exit with free Wi-Fi, a cheap late-night seat, though power outlets are not confirmed.

name: Coffee Aristocrat Edinburgh
address: 3-2-4 Shinjuku, Shinjuku M&E Square Building 2F, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo
description: A 24-hour classic kissaten (a traditional Japanese coffee house) by Shinjuku-sanchome Station with free Wi-Fi and power outlets you may use, good for a calm late-night stop.
